Popular crates: comparison

This reference page compares several widely used Rust crates. The table lists each crate with its latest version at the time of writing and a one line summary. Use it as a starting point when choosing dependencies for a new project, and always check the maintenance status first.

CrateVersionDescription
serde1.0.228Serialization framework
tokio1.47.1Async runtime
regex1.12.2Regular expressions
clap4.5.48Command line parser
anyhow1.0.100Flexible error type
rayon1.11.0Data parallelism

Versions change often, so treat the numbers above as a snapshot. The summaries come from each crate's own documentation and are intentionally brief. Where two crates overlap, the better choice usually depends on your platform and your tolerance for compile time.
